  {
    "commit": {
      "id": "7d23ecb2c29fbab76d86aca3297ce230810f8130",
      "message": "fix(dashboard): include a canceled deploy's continued pre-deploy output (w4/m198)

A canceled deploy whose already-running pre-deploy step finished afterward
(ADR004, w5/085) closed its default log window at the cancellation, so the
step's final success/error line was missing and searching it said "No
matching logs" even though the step read succeeded/failed.

The deploy page now resolves that deploy's own pre_deploy_ended fact through
the existing typed, cursor-paged serviceEvents read (matched on
details.deployId, frozen [createdAt, updatedAt+skew] interval) and ends the
default window at the later of finishedAt and the fact's whole second.
finishedAt, duration and all API adapters still mean the cancellation; ?r=
ranges are unchanged. While the fact resolves the panel shows its loading
state instead of the truncated window; a missing fact or failed read keeps
the cancellation bound with an explicit notice (and retry). useDeploy keeps
polling a canceled deploy whose step still reads canceled for the step Job's
bounded lifetime, so a historical canceled deploy picks up its late verdict.

UI before: default Deploy window omitted post-cancel step output. After: the
completion/error marker appears once, including when searched."
